headline: Expanse Lines Lock Three-Three as Linn Mercy's Lists Lengthen
war_summary: Since our last edition the Weathered Expanse has yielded no further ground to either side alone: the Colonial flag is back upon a third stand, leaving three apiece and three in ruin after fifty-three movements, Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest still the busiest grounds. The Nevish Line, which blazed at our last writing, has gone momentarily still, no flag moving there in two hours, yet thirty-eight shifts in a day tell of Tomb Father, Grief Mother and Mistle Shrine drawn into the fight beside Blackcoat Way and Blinding Stones; five Warden posts, two Colonial and one ruin hold that ground. Linn Mercy's lists lengthen fastest, eight and a half thousand Warden casualties against four thousand eight hundred Colonial in a day, Lathair and Outwich Ranch again the storm-centres. Marban Hollow still seesaws about Checkpoint Bua, which alone accounts for twenty-seven of thirty-five movements. Mooring County's Wind Hills traded flags fifteen times while Colonial losses outpaced Warden, though every post there remains Warden-held. Stlican Shelf stirs anew about Briar; Kuura Strand has lain quiet since mid-afternoon. Callahans Passage raises no flag, yet its daily ledger, above fourteen thousand names, remains the war's heaviest. It is day 730; thirty-four victory towns must fall to decide this war, and no victor is yet declared.
